claims.claim: Part fits body, engine and suspension for all models of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Witness only observed a single headlight assembly, not body, engine, or suspension components, and headlights are model-specific, not universal across all makes/models.
Watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' is overlaid on the photo, not a mark on the physical part; no logo or part number visible on the housing.

risks.proof: Clear shot of part number or OEM sticker on the back of the housing, or a VIN/fitment chart match
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/universal-fit generic part, not model-confirmed

risks.proof: Close-up of manufacturer logo, part number, and casting marks inside the housing

risks.risk: Electrical connector and bulb condition unknown
risks.proof: Photo or video of the rear connector plug and bulb sockets, ideally with bulbs inserted and powered
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested electrical, possible missing/damaged bulbs or connectors

risks.risk: Internal lens damage (cracks, fogging, water intrusion)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens from multiple angles in good light, including interior view
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible lens degradation

risks.risk: Left or right side designation not confirmed
risks.proof: Full front-facing shot showing turn signal placement relative to vehicle centerline, or label on part
risks.if_unproven: priced as side-unconfirmed, buyer risk of wrong side

risks.proof: Close-up of all mounting points and tabs on the housing edges
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potentially broken or missing mounting hardware

proof_requests: Clear photo of any part number, OEM sticker, or casting mark on the housing
Photo of the rear connector and bulb sockets
Close-up of the lens interior for cracks or moisture
Confirmation of exact vehicle make, model, and year this unit was pulled from
Photo showing which side (left/right) this unit is for
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a single car headlight assembly of unconfirmed make/model/side, so it can be priced at worst case (generic/unconfirmed fitment, unverified condition) while the seller's broad universal-fit claim is unsupported and likely inaccurate for a single headlight.
